dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: We meet again, Honorary Knight. As you can see, the Knights are currently piloting Wargaming simulations. If you can spare the time, we hope you can assist us in completing the testing.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: I'm Phonia, intelligence officer of the reorganized 7th Company, and also the one who proposed this Wargame.

response.speaker: Traveler
response.text: Ah, I remember now. You were the one by Cider Lake...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Yes. My thanks for your assistance in the "Annihilate the Invasive Anglers" operation back then, Honorary Knight.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Back then, I was still a Signals Officer of the Investigative Team, responsible for testing alchemical recon instruments developed by Captain Albedo.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: However, in light of how the Knights of Favonius have updated their tactics and the staffing structure now that some units from the expeditionary force have returned, Captain Albedo applied to have me assigned to the reorganized 7th Company.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Regardless, I'm just an ordinary "cog" in the Knights of Favonius "machine." I'm honored that you remember me at all, in fact.

response.speaker: Traveler
response.text: I'm sorry, but I really don't remember you...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Yes. As I'm sure you've seen, the scourge of monsters wandering the wilds remains one of the issues that all nations in Teyvat must deal with.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: In short, I've drawn inspiration from the Millelith General Staff's previous methods, collating all manner of reports in order to construct this Wargame.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: By simulating battles between monsters, we can learn the best strategies to defeat them while in a non-combat environment. If you're interested, please give it a try yourself.

response.speaker: Traveler
response.text: It looks like... a game of chess?

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: You're certainly right about that. There are indeed similarities between the conduct of Wargames and chess, so the comparison is quite apt.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: "Playing chess" is enough to help conduct valuable tactical analysis, and that's also where the charm of Wargames lie. You can just think of it as a regular "chess game."

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: In any case, I've applied for permission from the Acting Grand Master. Everyone is free to take part in these simulations, and all participants will be entitled to a thank-you gift.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: So if you have the time, Honorary Knight, I hope that you, too, will take part in our simulations. After all, I doubt that there are many in Mondstadt who know more about monsters than you do.

choices.text: I see. I'll give it a go when I have time, then.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: My thanks. We've already prepared the board, so we can begin at any time. I look forward to witnessing a commanding performance from you, Honorary Knight.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: The battlefield brims with uncertainty. No matter how thorough the investigation, the fog of war, which no wind can disperse, will still shroud about three-quarters of it.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: As such, the more participants we get, the more likely we can simulate even the most unpredictable of monster behavior patterns.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: All strategy and theory can only be based on real tactical results. No matter what the battle situation, only the success of our strategies can determine victory or defeat.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Such simulations help to expose our weaknesses, such that we Knights can improve them in real future combat scenarios.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: It's alright. Analyzing the simulation results is an intelligence officer's duty, Honorary Knight. You, as the commander, do not have to fret over these details. Just focus on doing battle.

choices.text: Got it. So I'll play the chess, and you'll do the rest?

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Precisely. Analyzing the simulation results is an intelligence officer's duty, Honorary Knight. You, as the commander, do not have to fret over these details — simply command.

choices.text: Well, I'll leave you to it then. See you.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Then we'll talk more next time, Honorary Knight.
